items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They let me play Lullaby of the Leaves with the band.

ctx.x: LaRue’s Supper Club. I would come up there. I would have my little busboy jacket. They let me play Lullaby of the Leaves with the band. They thought that was something, because they would let – and unfortunately there I had another friend working there – a busboy – who had a wonderful voice. He was very, very dark- skinned. Denny Dutton would have him sing and walk behind him when they did Me and My Shadow. I’m not sure that we would have accepted that now. But the people were starting to realize . . . Then I…
